question: When do I pay double holiday pay for Brouwerij Van de Leie?

answer.answer: For Brouwerij Van de Leie, double holiday pay is advanced to the April payroll, based on a company agreement. This overrides the default May/June timing in the Belgian policy.

conflicts.summary: Policy says May/June; the client agreement says April.
conflicts.resolution: Client-specific agreement overrides the default policy (DOC-001 allows this).

exceptions.summary: Client agreement advances double holiday pay to April every year.

reasons: Exception found only in an email and a draft note
